patch.value: TDD sequence: pin exact argv in unit and wrapper tests first; add a real installed-CLI receipt assertion including empty legacy aliases; implement canonical command and unbounded controls; migrate user-facing terminology; upgrade exact SDK/host floors; regenerate the package changelog; run privacy, merge, health, release, packed npm/npx and Bun/bunx acceptance.
Use canonical unbounded list reads with pm CLI 2026.8.20

Implement GitHub #147 and the companion fleet migration for pm-changelog. The package currently invokes deprecated list-all without universal unbounded output controls, so pm CLI 2026.8.20 warns and can return a deliberately compacted corpus that the fail-closed reader must reject. Upgrade the host/SDK contract to 2026.8.20 and construct canonical list --all reads with explicit unbounded amount and cost controls.

buildPmListArgs returns exact canonical global-flag ordering and cannot be regressed to list-all; caller pmArgs stay before host-supplied output controls without overriding the correctness contract; real installed pm 2026.8.20 acceptance over the package tracker returns count=total, complete, no omissions, no pagination/truncation, and empty legacy_aliases_used; fake-wrapper tests prove both include-body branches, max-buffer behavior, nonzero diagnostics, and caller args; docs and errors use canonical terminology; manifest host floor, exact dev pin, peer floor, and lockfile all target 2026.8.20; npm run release:check passes exact all-source coverage, docstrings, audit, pack, and deterministic changelog

Run pm-changelog 2026.8.17 on a non-trivial tracker with @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.20 and no --pm-arg overrides; observe the incomplete receipt refusal. Inspect buildPmListArgs and see list-all without --output-budget/--output-limit unbounded.

Every live tracker read invokes pm with --output-budget unbounded --output-limit unbounded list --all --json, preserves optional include-body and caller-provided global pm args, receives a complete no-omission receipt on a real non-trivial tracker, and emits no deprecated-alias diagnostic. The package exact coverage/docstring/release gates remain green under @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.20.

pm-changelog 2026.8.17 builds argv ending list-all --json without output controls. Installed pm 2026.8.20 deprecates the alias and its default output budget can compact a 45-item tracker to five rows, causing correct but avoidable fail-closed refusal.

Without the fix, default changelog generation refuses legitimate medium-sized workspaces and agent stderr includes a deprecation warning; weakening the refusal instead would silently omit release notes.
